findings.summary: Valid rebind between different owner versions fails.
findings.evidence: Independent pure resolver reproduces the same old/new owner baseline mismatch as B2.
findings.action: Resolver validates the previous owner baseline independently of destination scope. Executor uses the dependency simulator owner before each operation against initial root versions; distinct-version and sequential-owner tests pass.

findings.evidence: Note mapping is valid but all imported Cards get sync membership, which the new outbound Note guard rejects. Preserve source-only provenance.
findings.action: Incoming human/MCP builders retain Note canonical provenance without active sync rows and report every imported item; mixed imports pass.

findings.summary: Direct imports pool parent Issue numbers across repositories.
findings.evidence: The direct parent index includes every joined link; Agent import already filters repository.
findings.action: Direct parent indexing now filters canonical repository before Issue-number lookup; cross-repository regression passes.

findings.summary: Rebind compares old-owner baseVersion against destination owner.
findings.evidence: Both previous and new referenceOwner calls assert the same operation baseline; unequal owner versions reject valid rebind.
findings.action: Resolver validates the previous owner baseline independently of destination scope. Executor uses the dependency simulator owner before each operation against initial root versions; distinct-version and sequential-owner tests pass.

findings.summary: Unchanged canonical updates bump roots in core.
findings.evidence: Resolver finalizes every affected Card/Release even when owner/locator are unchanged; direct repository only finalizes actual identity change.
findings.action: Both direct and core canonical updates return unchanged when owner/scope/locator match; root/history no-op regression passes.

findings.evidence: Sync membership is removed while conflict rows remain; prepareConflictResolution requires the removed link.
findings.action: Identity rebind/detach atomically retires only obsolete open conflicts, records attributed before evidence, and preserves closed/unrelated conflicts; four direct/executor cases pass.

findings.summary: Human public mutation can edit a removed-map identity.
findings.evidence: Human application branch calls retained-owner repository directly without visible-owner check; internal maintenance must remain possible.
findings.action: Application update/delete validates visible owner through linkProjectId before mutation; actual HTTP refusal passes while retained citation maintenance remains available.

findings.summary: Sync does not update footer-only metadata on otherwise unchanged content.
findings.evidence: Current served origin is required when generating pushed content. Footer is intentionally excluded from merge hashes; no automatic metadata-only remote write requirement exists.

findings.summary: Complete footer after one newline survives stripping.
findings.evidence: Parser only admits start-of-body or two-newline prefix; a manually edited complete block can be duplicated. Also preserve malformed earlier delimiter prose.
findings.action: Parser recognizes complete non-nested blocks with short separators and preserves unmatched earlier prose;12 footer tests pass.

findings.summary: Token Milestone lookup omits later pages.
findings.evidence: Token listMilestones first-page lookup is unchanged from baseline; CLI pagination was repaired here. Separate provider pagination work remains.

findings.summary: Non-GitHub externalRef.deleted history is erased or rejected.
findings.evidence: Archive predicates act on action alone although valid historical Activity permits non-GitHub refs; whole-payload handling must inspect typed GitHub evidence.
findings.action: Typed GitHub-only whole-event predicates and scoped deletion reads preserve valid non-GitHub history; archive roundtrip/refusal tests pass.

findings.summary: Archive scans materialize all serialized history.
findings.evidence: New redaction/validation .all() loads complete Activity/ChangeSet/Card history tables before processing; iterate to bound retained payload memory.
findings.action: Serialized payload scanners use32-row keyset batches;3×257-row history test verifies full processing without a new timing threshold.

findings.summary: Diff alone cannot prove exact skill execution or absence of temporary sprint writes.
findings.evidence: Actual parent transcript records the exact renderer invocation once and only explicitly scoped writes/staging; protected file remains unchanged. No claimed code defect.

findings.summary: Detailed scope might be self-authored expansion of story identifier.
findings.evidence: Binding story-plan7.3 and epic7 preparation predate this diff and were loaded before planning; the spec refines their existing requirements.
CUA inventory exposes no browser surface. DOM anchors and actual HTTP listener/SDK routes pass; native browser/reader observation would settle the boundary.

findings.summary: Live GitHub account behavior is unverified.
findings.evidence: Controlled provider and CLI transports prove local behavior; a separately authorized live account smoke would establish live access. No login or real credentials used.

findings.summary: Existing prototype Project conversion is not demonstrated.
findings.evidence: AD9 and binding detail plan explicitly exclude prototype migration/backfill; populated current-schema reopen/Restore is the required surface.

findings.action: Both auth modes now exercise successful malformed continuation pages and assert rejection.

findings.evidence: Pre-verified gap: Tree covers paired projections; Card Detail fixture has empty sync rows, so duplicate detail rows could regress undetected.
